definition.zh: 围绕复杂或陌生主题制定检索路径，从学术数据库、专业文献、开源社区、软件生态和多种公开渠道发现资料与工具。能够交叉比较来源、追溯原始信息、判断可靠性与合规性，并把分散内容整理为可用于创作、技术决策或学术写作的研究基础。
definition.en: Builds search strategies for complex or unfamiliar topics, discovering information and tools across academic databases, professional literature, open-source communities, software ecosystems and diverse public sources. Cross-checks evidence, traces original sources, evaluates reliability and compliance, and organises fragmented material into a foundation for creative work, technical decisions or academic writing.

definition.zh: 根据研究问题设计数据收集方式，对原始数据进行整理、清理、结构化和分析，再选择合适的图表与视觉语言解释结果。相关实践包括本科毕业论文中对中国服装产业出口隐含碳数据的处理、分析与可视化，能够把定量结果转化为清晰且可核查的论证。
definition.en: Designs data-collection methods around a research question, then organises, cleans, structures and analyses raw data before selecting suitable charts and visual language. This includes processing, analysing and visualising embodied-carbon data for Chinese garment exports in an undergraduate thesis, translating quantitative results into clear and verifiable arguments.

definition.zh: 把复杂问题拆解为目标、限制、资源和底层机制，不依赖惯例直接接受既有答案。能够从第一性原理重新建立推理链，比较不同方案的条件与后果，并把抽象判断转化为可验证的设计、研究或技术行动。
definition.en: Breaks complex problems into goals, constraints, resources and underlying mechanisms rather than accepting conventional answers at face value. Rebuilds reasoning from first principles, compares the conditions and consequences of alternatives, and translates abstract judgement into testable design, research or technical action.

definition.zh: 能够独立推进完整服装开发：从研究和概念设计开始，通过效果图明确廓形与细节，再使用平裁、立裁和样版设计形成可制作结构。随后完成样衣、缝纫、Fitting、问题判断、修版和最终成衣；《墙》《灵》《根》集中体现了这套从设计到落地的全流程能力。
definition.en: Independently leads complete garment development: beginning with research and concept design, defining silhouette and detail through illustration, then translating ideas into buildable structures through flat cutting, draping and pattern development. Continues through toile making, sewing, fitting, diagnosis, pattern revision and final garment; Wall, Spirit and Root demonstrate this full design-to-production process.

definition.zh: 把材料研究作为设计方法，而不仅是成品表面处理。能够操作手摇横机进行针织设计与制作，并运用草木染、纱线再造、面料改造、轻黏土和混合材料绘画等方式改变材料的结构、颜色、触感与叙事，使实验结果进一步进入服装、装置或视觉作品。
definition.en: Uses material research as a design method rather than treating it as surface decoration. Works with a hand flat knitting machine and applies botanical dyeing, yarn reconstruction, textile transformation, lightweight clay and mixed-media painting to alter structure, colour, tactility and narrative, carrying experimental outcomes into garments, installations or visual works.

definition.zh: 能够把首饰概念发展为银黏土成品，完整处理造型设计、塑形、干燥与烧制前准备、烧结收缩、镶嵌、修整、打磨、抛光和最终表面效果。也具有手工皮具制作经验，能够根据材料特性安排结构、加工顺序与细节完成度。
definition.en: Develops jewellery concepts into finished silver-clay pieces, handling form design, shaping, drying and pre-firing preparation, sintering shrinkage, setting, refinement, sanding, polishing and final surface treatment. Also has leathercraft experience, planning structure, process order and detail according to material behaviour.

definition.zh: 从主题、叙事和观众体验出发建立影片的整体方向，并把概念转换为可执行的剧本、镜头、表演和视听选择。能够协调摄影、演员、造型、声音与后期，使各环节服务于统一表达；在GLITCH IN THE HIVE中覆盖从前期构思到最终成片的核心导演职责。
definition.en: Establishes a film's overall direction from theme, narrative and audience experience, translating concepts into executable writing, shots, performances and audiovisual choices. Coordinates cinematography, cast, styling, sound and post-production around a unified expression; GLITCH IN THE HIVE demonstrates this responsibility from early concept through final film.

definition.zh: 能够根据叙事、人物和空间选择镜头、构图、光线、机位与运动方式，完成静态摄影和动态影像拍摄。除实际操作摄影设备外，也能进行Reference搜集、勘景、画面风格规划，并与导演、妆造和调色环节建立连续的视觉语言。
definition.en: Selects lenses, composition, lighting, camera position and movement according to narrative, character and space, working across still photography and moving-image capture. Beyond camera operation, conducts reference research, location scouting and visual planning, connecting direction, styling and colour grading into a continuous visual language.

definition.zh: 把抽象概念、哲学命题或世界观发展为具有节奏和可执行性的叙事结构，进一步写成场景、人物行动、旁白和台词。写作不仅服务故事内容，也会考虑画面、声音、表演和剪辑如何共同传达信息，并延伸到歌词、短文与创意文本。
definition.en: Develops abstract concepts, philosophical propositions or world-building into paced, executable narrative structures, then into scenes, character actions, voice-over and dialogue. Writing considers how image, sound, performance and editing communicate together, and extends into lyrics, short prose and creative texts.

definition.zh: 从素材备份、命名、筛选和项目结构开始，建立可持续的后期工作流，并在DaVinci Resolve中完成剪辑、节奏调整、调色、特效、配音、AI变声及声音整合。理解不同编码格式、色彩空间和交付规格，也使用DaVinci Resolve Project Server支持局域网协作。
definition.en: Builds a sustainable post-production workflow from backup, naming, selection and project structure, then completes editing, pacing, colour grading, effects, voice work, AI voice transformation and sound integration in DaVinci Resolve. Understands codecs, colour spaces and delivery formats, and uses DaVinci Resolve Project Server for local-network collaboration.

definition.zh: 能够独立完成作词、作曲与编曲，从旋律、和声、节奏、音色和段落结构发展原创音乐。创作既包括独立歌曲，也能针对影片、表演或交互作品设计背景音乐与情绪推进，使音乐与叙事、画面和时间结构发生关系。
definition.en: Independently writes lyrics, composes and arranges original music through melody, harmony, rhythm, timbre and sectional structure. Work includes standalone songs as well as background music and emotional progression for film, performance or interactive projects, relating music to narrative, image and temporal structure.

definition.zh: 使用EQ、动态处理、空间、声像、音色和整体响度组织音乐、影片与交互作品中的声音。能够区分和配置电容麦、动圈麦等设备，理解音频信号链，并把声音分析参数进一步映射到视觉、3D模型、灯光或硬件控制中。
definition.en: Organises sound for music, film and interactive work through EQ, dynamics, space, panning, timbre and overall loudness. Selects and configures equipment such as condenser and dynamic microphones, understands audio signal chains, and maps analysed sound parameters onto visuals, 3D models, lighting or hardware control.

definition.zh: 能够把概念发展为完整3D作品，涵盖常规与Geometry Nodes程序化建模、雕刻、场景搭建、材质、灯光、动画和最终渲染。《幻》体现了从视觉设计到动画输出的全流程；同时了解3D扫描、打印准备、材料选择、可制造性和成本测算。
definition.en: Develops concepts into complete 3D works through conventional and Geometry Nodes procedural modelling, sculpting, scene building, materials, lighting, animation and final rendering. Huan demonstrates the full path from visual design to animated output; practice also covers 3D scanning, print preparation, material selection, manufacturability and cost estimation.

definition.zh: 使用Processing、TouchDesigner、Three.js等工具把代码、数据和实时图形转化为视觉艺术、3D网页及交互体验。能够设计参数之间的映射关系，把用户输入、声音、传感器或网络数据转化为动态画面，并在浏览器、装置和表演环境中完成原型。
definition.en: Uses tools such as Processing, TouchDesigner and Three.js to translate code, data and real-time graphics into visual art, 3D websites and interactive experiences. Designs parameter mappings that transform user input, sound, sensors or network data into moving images, prototyping across browsers, installations and performance contexts.

definition.zh: 通过民族文化、宗教学、生物科学、社会议题和技术趋势研究，构建关于未来生活方式与价值系统的设计命题。能够把《千高原》等哲学概念转化为世界观、情境、物件或交互系统，运用Speculative Design与Provocative Design引发讨论，而不是只预测单一未来。
definition.en: Builds design propositions about future ways of living and value systems through research into culture, religion, biological science, social issues and technological change. Translates philosophical concepts such as A Thousand Plateaus into worlds, scenarios, objects or interactive systems, using speculative and provocative design to open debate rather than predict a single future.

definition.zh: 能够设计文生图、图生视频、文生视频与首尾帧工作流，通过提示词工程、参考图、参数迭代和结果评估控制画面方向与连续性。会筛选、修正和组织生成素材，并通过剪辑、调色和后期处理把AIGC结果融入完整视听作品；Digital Alchemy记录了Veo 3.1所处技术阶段的相关实践。
definition.en: Designs text-to-image, image-to-video, text-to-video and first/last-frame workflows, using prompt engineering, reference images, parameter iteration and evaluation to control visual direction and continuity. Selects, corrects and organises generated material, integrating it into complete audiovisual work through editing, colour grading and post-production; Digital Alchemy documents this practice in the technological period represented by Veo 3.1.

definition.zh: 能够从信息架构、UI/UX和视觉语言出发，编写前端界面并连接数据、API与自动化流程，最终部署到Vercel和自定义域名。实践包含个人网站、3D交互网页、问卷系统与小型工具，重视响应式布局、可维护代码、版本管理和从概念到上线的完整闭环。
definition.en: Develops digital products from information architecture, UI/UX and visual language through frontend implementation, data and API integration, automation, and deployment to Vercel and custom domains. Practice includes a personal website, interactive 3D sites, survey systems and small utilities, with attention to responsive layout, maintainable code, version control and the full path from concept to release.

definition.zh: 在面对新需求时优先调研GitHub和开源生态，比较项目功能、维护状态、依赖、许可证、文档与实施成本。能够阅读现有代码和配置，完成本地部署、问题定位及针对性修改，并把开源组件整合进网页、自动化工具或创意技术项目。
definition.en: Begins new technical needs by researching GitHub and the open-source ecosystem, comparing functionality, maintenance, dependencies, licences, documentation and implementation cost. Reads existing code and configuration, deploys locally, diagnoses issues, makes targeted modifications and integrates open-source components into websites, automation utilities or creative-technology projects.

definition.zh: 能够调用语言模型和生成式模型API，设计输入输出结构，并将模型能力接入网站、Unity程序与自动化工作流。也会使用AI Agent和不同MCP服务连接本地文件、软件与资料库，使模型输出参与内容生成、数据处理、交互逻辑和项目归档，而不只停留在聊天界面使用。
definition.en: Calls language-model and generative-model APIs, designs input/output structures and integrates model capabilities into websites, Unity applications and automated workflows. Uses AI agents and multiple MCP services to connect local files, software and libraries, allowing model output to participate in content generation, data processing, interaction logic and project archiving rather than remaining confined to chat interfaces.

definition.zh: 使用OSC、MIDI和Serial/UART在Unity、TouchDesigner、音频软件、微控制器与外部硬件之间建立实时通信。能够规划消息与参数映射、配置端口和波特率、解析数据并排查延迟或连接问题；也在macOS上使用虚拟MIDI协调多个软件与音频输出的同步控制。
definition.en: Builds real-time communication among Unity, TouchDesigner, audio software, microcontrollers and external hardware through OSC, MIDI and Serial/UART. Plans messages and parameter mappings, configures ports and baud rates, parses data and diagnoses latency or connection issues; also uses virtual MIDI on macOS to coordinate multiple applications and synchronised control of audio outputs.

definition.zh: 使用Arduino、ESP32和STM32连接传感器、灯光与执行部件，完成基础电路、焊接、串口通信和控制逻辑。能够让硬件数据进入TouchDesigner、Unity或其他软件，再把数字内容反馈到实体设备；案例包括STM32自动浇水系统和Arduino服装灯光交互。
definition.en: Uses Arduino, ESP32 and STM32 to connect sensors, lighting and actuators, handling basic circuitry, soldering, serial communication and control logic. Routes hardware data into TouchDesigner, Unity or other software and returns digital output to physical devices; examples include an STM32 automated-watering system and Arduino garment-light interaction.

definition.zh: 从初中开始独立组装电脑，也为他人完成过多台设备。能够根据用途和预算选择CPU、主板、内存、显卡、电源、散热与存储，判断尺寸、功耗和接口兼容性，并完成普通及ITX紧凑主机的装配、散热布局和整洁理线，同时处理升级、重装系统和常见硬件故障。
definition.en: Has independently built computers since secondary school and has assembled multiple systems for other people. Selects CPUs, motherboards, memory, graphics, power, cooling and storage according to purpose and budget; evaluates dimensions, power and interface compatibility; completes standard and compact ITX builds with thermal planning and clean cable management; and handles upgrades, operating-system installation and common hardware faults.

definition.zh: 能够在Linux与VPS上部署和维护服务，配置NAS、软路由、虚拟机、安全远程访问和本地/远程影视库。家庭服务器通过虚拟化同时承担NAS与网络出口功能，也尝试过为机顶盒刷入系统进行设备改造；同时规划硬盘、云端与NAS的多端备份、文件系统和跨Mac/Windows的数据使用。
definition.en: Deploys and maintains services on Linux and VPS infrastructure, configuring NAS, soft routing, virtual machines, secure remote access and local/remote media libraries. A virtualised home server combines NAS and network-gateway functions, while set-top boxes have been repurposed through alternative system installation; work also covers multi-location backup across disks, cloud and NAS, file systems and cross-platform data use between macOS and Windows.

definition.zh: 通过理解电源、接口、机械结构和基本电路原理判断设备故障，而不是只按固定教程操作。能够拆装电脑、键盘、桌椅家具和小型电器，进行数据保护、系统修复、零件替换、电子焊接与电池更换；曾为亏电筋膜枪购买适配电池并完成维修。
definition.en: Diagnoses faults by understanding power, interfaces, mechanical structure and basic circuitry rather than following fixed instructions alone. Disassembles and reassembles computers, keyboards, furniture and small appliances; protects data, repairs systems, replaces parts, solders electronics and changes batteries; one example involved sourcing a compatible battery and restoring a deeply discharged massage gun.

definition.zh: 根据声音来源、空间和用途选择电容麦、动圈麦等麦克风，规划前级、接口、监听、录制软件与输出之间的信号链。能够搭建个人录音系统、配置音频和MIDI路由、判断电平与噪声问题，并通过摆位、吸声和反射控制进行基础声学处理。
definition.en: Selects condenser, dynamic and other microphones according to source, space and purpose, planning signal flow across preamps, interfaces, monitoring, recording software and output. Builds personal recording systems, configures audio and MIDI routing, diagnoses level and noise issues, and applies basic acoustic treatment through positioning, absorption and reflection control.

definition.zh: 能够在时尚、影像、音乐、表演和技术人员之间翻译不同专业的语言，把抽象创意转化为可讨论的Reference、镜头、声音、材料和技术需求。既能独立承担多种角色，也能在团队中明确职责、交换素材、回应限制并保持整体概念一致。
definition.en: Translates between the languages of fashion, film, music, performance and technology, turning abstract ideas into discussable references, shots, sound, materials and technical requirements. Can take on multiple roles independently while also defining responsibilities, exchanging assets, responding to constraints and maintaining conceptual coherence in a team.

definition.zh: 曾教授他人CLO3D基础操作，能够把数字服装的界面、2D样版、缝合、3D模拟和基础输出拆解为适合初学者的步骤。教学过程中会结合服装结构解释软件操作的原因，并通过示范、练习和问题排查帮助学习者形成可独立复现的工作流程。
definition.en: Has taught CLO3D fundamentals, breaking the interface, 2D patterns, sewing, 3D simulation and basic output into steps suitable for beginners. Connects software operations to garment structure, using demonstration, practice and troubleshooting to help learners build a workflow they can reproduce independently.

definition.zh: 根据项目目标拆分研究、设计、拍摄、开发、后期和发布阶段，安排人员、设备、素材、文件结构、版本和交付节点。熟悉个人项目的全流程推进，也能使用DaVinci Resolve Project Server、GitHub和自动化工具支持多人协作、局域网后期与持续部署，降低素材丢失和版本混乱。
definition.en: Breaks project goals into research, design, shooting, development, post-production and release phases, coordinating people, equipment, assets, file structures, versions and delivery points. Manages complete independent projects and uses DaVinci Resolve Project Server, GitHub and automation to support collaboration, local-network post-production and continuous deployment while reducing asset loss and version confusion.

definition.zh: 围绕实际问题快速建立学习路径，主动寻找文档、论文、开源代码、课程和社区经验，并通过小型实验验证理解。长期追踪AI与新兴技术，也能把服装、声音、3D、硬件、研究和编程中的原理相互迁移，形成个人Wiki、Zotero与AI Agent结合的持续知识系统。
definition.en: Builds learning paths around practical problems, actively finding documentation, papers, open-source code, courses and community knowledge, then testing understanding through small experiments. Continuously follows AI and emerging technology, transfers principles among fashion, sound, 3D, hardware, research and programming, and maintains an evolving knowledge system combining a personal Wiki, Zotero and AI agents.

definition.zh: 长期保持健身与有氧运动习惯，实践包含跑步、骑行和乒乓球，并重视睡眠与恢复。能够根据距离、体力和连续天数调整节奏、补给和行程；从杭州到南京的五日骑行体现了耐力、持续执行和长途活动管理。
definition.en: Maintains long-term fitness and aerobic practice across running, cycling and table tennis, with attention to sleep and recovery. Adjusts pace, nutrition and scheduling according to distance, physical capacity and consecutive days; the five-day cycle from Hangzhou to Nanjing demonstrates endurance, sustained execution and long-distance activity management.

definition.zh: 具备日常道路驾驶能力，也能在海外环境中根据当地交通规则、道路条件、车辆差异和路线安排完成自驾。曾在挪威及希腊扎金索斯独立自驾，过程中需要结合导航、停车、补给、天气和行程变化进行实际判断。
definition.en: Drives in everyday road conditions and adapts to overseas environments by interpreting local rules, road conditions, vehicle differences and route plans. Has self-driven in Norway and Zakynthos, Greece, making practical decisions around navigation, parking, refuelling, weather and changing itineraries.

definition.zh: 具有长期独立生活和大量独立旅行经验，能够完成目的地调研、交通住宿比较、路线与预算规划、物资准备、风险判断和跨文化适应。英国签证、多次申根签证和十年美国签证均由本人独立准备资料与申请，能够把复杂行政要求转化为有序的文件和时间计划。
definition.en: Has extensive experience of independent living and travel, covering destination research, transport and accommodation comparison, route and budget planning, packing, risk judgement and cross-cultural adaptation. Independently prepared and submitted documentation for a UK visa, multiple Schengen visas and a ten-year US visa, translating complex administrative requirements into organised files and timelines.

definition.zh: 长期独立烹饪，能够处理多种菜式和食材，根据原料状态、火候、质地、调味和营养搭配调整制作方法。对咖啡、茶、酒及餐饮风味具有持续体验，能够比较香气、酸甜苦、口感、余味与食物搭配，并把感官判断反馈到实际制作。
definition.en: Has cooked independently over a long period across a broad range of dishes and ingredients, adapting methods according to condition, heat, texture, seasoning and nutritional balance. Maintains sustained experience with coffee, tea, alcohol and food flavour, comparing aroma, acidity, sweetness, bitterness, mouthfeel, finish and pairing, then feeding sensory judgement back into preparation.

definition.zh: 深入了解不同咖啡器具与萃取方式，实际使用过手冲、手压和气动咖啡设备。能够根据豆种、烘焙程度、研磨粗细、水温、粉水比、压力和时间调整方案，并通过酸度、甜感、苦味、醇厚度和干净度判断萃取结果。
definition.en: Understands multiple coffee tools and extraction methods, with practical experience using pour-over, manual-pressure and pneumatic equipment. Adjusts approach according to bean, roast, grind size, water temperature, ratio, pressure and time, evaluating extraction through acidity, sweetness, bitterness, body and clarity.

definition.zh: 具备围棋业余三段水平，能够结合局部计算、全局形势判断、厚薄、先后手和长期方向进行对弈。围棋训练也强化了在不完全信息下比较变化、控制风险、接受取舍并持续修正计划的能力。
definition.en: Plays Go at amateur 3-dan level, combining local calculation with global positional judgement, influence, initiative and long-term direction. Go practice also strengthens the ability to compare variations under incomplete information, manage risk, accept trade-offs and continually revise plans.

definition.zh: 了解灭火器的基本检查和操作顺序，能够完成取用、解锁、保持安全距离、瞄准火源根部和控制喷射。该能力仅表述初期灭火器操作，不替代专业消防训练；在无法安全控制的情况下应优先撤离并联系紧急服务。
definition.en: Understands basic extinguisher checks and operating sequence, including retrieval, release, maintaining a safe distance, aiming at the base of a fire and controlling discharge. This describes initial extinguisher operation only, not professional firefighting training; evacuation and emergency services take priority when a situation cannot be controlled safely.

definition.zh: 把服装设计、面料改造、人体活动与嵌入式硬件放在同一系统中思考，使用Arduino等微控制器连接灯光、传感器与控制逻辑。能够处理电路隐藏、重量、供电、活动空间和视觉效果之间的平衡，使技术真正进入服装结构，而不是作为外加装饰。
definition.en: Treats fashion design, textile transformation, bodily movement and embedded hardware as one system, using microcontrollers such as Arduino to connect lighting, sensors and control logic. Balances circuit concealment, weight, power, movement and visual effect so technology becomes part of the garment structure rather than an attached decoration.

definition.zh: 分析声音中的频率、音量、节奏和动态变化，并将其映射到TouchDesigner或Unity中的3D模型、材质、动画和视觉参数。能够设计平滑、阈值、缩放和响应速度，使画面既准确响应声音又保持可读的视觉节奏；SonySIE项目体现了这种实时视听关系。
definition.en: Analyses frequency, volume, rhythm and dynamic change in sound, mapping them onto 3D models, materials, animation and visual parameters in TouchDesigner or Unity. Designs smoothing, thresholds, scaling and response speed so imagery reacts accurately while retaining a legible visual rhythm; the SonySIE project demonstrates this real-time audiovisual relationship.

definition.zh: 从表演时间线和观众体验出发，综合考虑配音、混音、背景音乐、音效、灯光、实时视觉、硬件输入与表演动作。能够利用TouchDesigner、OSC、MIDI和音频分析协调不同系统，使技术提示、舞台节奏和叙事变化保持同步，并具有少量实际舞台演出经验。
definition.en: Approaches performance through timeline and audience experience, coordinating voice, mixing, background music, effects, lighting, real-time visuals, hardware input and performer action. Uses TouchDesigner, OSC, MIDI and audio analysis to synchronise technical cues, stage rhythm and narrative change, supported by some practical stage-performance experience.

definition.zh: 能够把用户输入、数据处理、AI生成、版本管理和网站发布连接成无人值守的流程。Obfuscation Identity Archive中，SurveyJS问卷数据自动归档到GitHub，系统调用生图API生成并提交图片，前端读取更新后的数据，再由Vercel自动部署到个人域名，形成从参与到公开归档的完整闭环。
definition.en: Connects user input, data processing, AI generation, version control and web publishing into an unattended workflow. In Obfuscation Identity Archive, SurveyJS responses are archived to GitHub, an image-generation API creates and commits images, the frontend reads updated data, and Vercel deploys automatically to a personal domain, forming a complete loop from participation to public archive.

definition.zh: 构建以本地Wiki为核心的个人知识库，使用wiki-agent进行内容摄取、查询、检查和关系整理，并通过MCP调用Zotero文献库及其他软件。能够把阅读资料、引用、研究笔记和写作上下文组织为可追溯流程，让AI Agent辅助学术写作时仍保留来源和知识结构。
definition.en: Builds a personal knowledge base around a local Wiki, using wiki-agent for ingestion, querying, checking and relationship management, and MCP to access Zotero and other software. Organises readings, citations, research notes and writing context into a traceable workflow, allowing AI agents to assist academic writing while preserving sources and knowledge structure.

definition.zh: 研究折纸的折线、展开方式和体积变化，并把二维纸张逻辑转化为服装廓形、样版分割和可活动结构。通过纸样实验、立裁与Fitting反复验证人体尺度、材料厚度和运动空间，使形式创新能够进入真实可穿着的服装。
definition.en: Studies folds, unfolding logic and volumetric transformation in origami, translating two-dimensional paper logic into garment silhouettes, pattern divisions and articulated structures. Repeatedly tests body scale, material thickness and movement through paper experiments, draping and fitting so formal innovation becomes genuinely wearable.
